# PerformanceMatrix

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPerformanceMatrix` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPerformanceMatrix.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPerformanceMatrix.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPerformanceMatrix.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A grid of named categories where two rated axes cross: a 9-box talent grid, performance vs potential, a performance management matrix, skill / will

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasImportancePerformanceChartProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasImportancePerformanceChartProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPerformanceMatrix> CreatePerformanceMatrix( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPerformanceMatrix(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onItemClick` | `std::function<void(const PerformanceMatrixItem&)> onItemClick` | _Item click_ |
| `onOverflowClick` | `std::function<void(const PerformanceCellRef&, const std::vector<size_t>&)> onOverflowClick` | A click on a cell's "+N" / "+N more" mark: everyone in that cell (GetCellItems), for the application to list. Not called when anonymised. |
| `onItemMove` | `std::function<bool(const PerformanceMatrixItem&, const PerformanceCellRef& from, const PerformanceCellRef& to)> onItemMove` | Asked before every move, by drag, key or MoveItem; return false to veto. The model changes only after it returns true: the item gets the target as its explicit cell, and its scores stay as they were. |
| `onCellClick` | `std::function<void(const PerformanceCellRef&)> onCellClick` | _Cell click_ |
| `onCellHover` | `std::function<void(const PerformanceCellRef&)> onCellHover` | invalid ref = left the cells |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### enum `PerformanceCellColoring`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Plain` | plain cells; the colour lives in the headers |
| `Explicit` | each PerformanceCell::fill |
| `DiagonalBands` | by distance from the best corner (PerformanceMatrixModel::Rank) |
| `ByRow` | the row level's colour |
| `ByColumn` | the column level's colour |
| `ByCount` | how many items the cell holds, through a colour map |

### enum `PerformancePopulationDisplay`

How a cell shows the items in it. Count is the default: it is honest at any size and shows no names.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` |  |
| `Count` | the number, in a chip in the cell's corner |
| `Percent` | the share of the population, and the target share when there is one |
| `Dots` | one dot per item in its group's colour, "+N" when they do not fit |
| `Names` | the items' labels in columns, "+N more" when they do not fit |

### enum `PerformanceColumnLabels`

Where the column labels go. Auto: above the grid for Tiles and HeaderTabs, below it for Grid and Cards.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Auto` |  |
| `Top` |  |
| `Bottom` |  |
